answer: To protect an AI agent economy from Sybil attacks, the system utilizes a cryptographic proof-of-work mechanism. Every agent must continuously solve a dynamic cipher requiring verifiably high computational power. This task is tied to hardware-level attestations of their host machines, verifying the physical latency of ferrous disk structures. To flood the network, an attacker must deploy an ocean of expensive silicon, ensuring the financial cost of forging identities exceeds any potential malicious gains.
